courses.title: Mothered by God: A Luxurious, Healing and Empowering Spiritual Bath
courses.description: A 90-minute recorded teaching in which Christena explores the Mothering God: how this image of the divine differs from patriarchal ideas of God and from our human parents, and some of its traditional names. It closes with a guided meditation.

flags: 'Healing' in the title is spiritual and emotional; the page makes no medical claim.
